## KHQR guideline
Use a dedicated **ABA KHQR** merchant account (merchant_id ending in `instore`). When the QR is scanned the payer enters amount/note (or the QR-data is pre-filled from `qr_data`); the `merchant_ref` lets you map the inbound transaction.

Hash: `req_time + merchant_id + merchant_ref`

Returns the last 50 transactions for that merchant_ref (10 req/min).

> **Sandbox note (2026-09):** demo profiles returned HTTP 404 with an empty body for this endpoint - KHQR retrieval appears to require the dedicated KHQR merchant profile. The path, hash order and limits here are docs-verified.
